summary: Read issue354,related/dossier/previous unreceived-esse attempt and InfinityEternity.lean; materialized/read complete pinned AQUINAS-ST-I-Q7-A1 and A2 with q3a4 context. New actual-route design finding: a1 distinguishes matter perfected/determined by form from received form contracted in amplitude by matter; a2 permits an immaterial subsistent created form to be unlimited relative to matter while its ESSE remains received in determinate nature. Receipt and limitation must therefore retain act/respect indexing. In the a2 created-form context, stated essence/esse nonidentity motivates reception, not the converse needed to infer nonreception from ROOT-ESSENCE-IDENTITY. The q3 Profile has no reception relation; bare equality of its Principle-valued maps supplies none. Proposed limitation-only-by-receiving-potency decomposition still needs identity-to-unreceived applicability, independently defended exhaustion of relevant formal esse restrictions, and faithful connection to existing primitive Infinite. A new name for no receiver-limitation would not prove the old equality-to-Infinite target. Detailed precise witnesses, source directions, positive semantic distinctions and design obligations persisted in docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md (plurality note owned by concurrent adversary). No new claim/definition/relation/Lean/model or premise change. Reception-to-composition follow-up: after reusing existing De ente/composition notes, materialized/read complete AQUINAS-DE-ENTE-C3-4 and AQUINAS-ST-I-Q3-A7. De ente c3[69874], paragraph after the efficient-cause/esse-tantum argument, explicitly treats what receives from another as potential with respect to the received item and the item as act; applies it to intellectual quiddity/received esse, then explains that-which-is/that-by-which constitution. C4[69875] second-mode paragraph relates finite esse to receiving-nature capacity while quiddity is unreceived in matter. This is positive source support for genuine receptive constitution, not words or generic predication. Crucial design correction: recipient is already actual with received esse; receptive potency is not the legacy unactualized InPotency n esse, so not-both cannot be used to contradict ExistingInActAt by silently equating these roles. Noncomposition can exclude independently justified real act/receiver constitution, but existing composition-inclusion record has only MF and esse/essence-nonidentity clauses, no receipt clause. Q3a7 fourth proof is composite-to-act/potency, not an unrestricted converse. De ente application follows prior nonidentity of the intellectual subjects; it is not an independent universal receipt-to-real-distinction proof against the new identity candidate. From-another causation and in-something receipt also require a justified connection. Exact source context, locators and role/type boundary persisted in the existing causal-perfection note. No framework/proof/model/claim change or independent burden removed.
blocker: Independently justify why the same candidate represented as essence=esse cannot have a genuine receiving principle, establish that all relevant limitations of its esse arise from appropriate receiving potency, and connect typed unrestricted formal perfection to the existing primitive Infinite semantics without hiding the target in a universal bridge. No current conditional implementation improves that route enough to authorize proof files. A noncomposition route would need independently justified actualized act/receiver real constitution mapped to the SAME Composite predicate. It must not import the legacy unactualized-potency not-both law; the source application already assumes intellectual essence/esse nonidentity, so no universal receipt-to-distinction discharge is claimed.
